claim.claim-text: 2. The lighting device of claim 1, wherein an upper surface of the second resin portion (233) has a curved surface.

3. The lighting device of claim 1, wherein the height of the second resin portion (233) in a vertical direction from the substrate is smaller than the height of the first resin portion (231) in the vertical direction.
4. The lighting device of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein an upper surface of the first resin portion is parallel to an upper surface of the substrate.
5. The lighting device of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the phosphor layer (240) has a curved portion disposed on the second resin portion (233).
6. The lighting device of any one of claims 1 to 5,

wherein the substrate (210) has a first substrate (211) disposed under the first resin portion (231) and a second substrate (213) disposed under the second resin portion (233), wherein the second substrate (213) of the substrate is horizontal from the first substrate, and wherein at least two light sources are disposed on each of the first and second substrates.

7. The lighting device of claim 6, wherein a vertical distance between the light source disposed on the first substrate (211) and the phosphor layer (240) has a distance greater than a vertical distance between the light source disposed on the second substrate (213) and the phosphor layer (240).
8. The lighting device of any one of claims 1 to 7,

wherein a lower portion of the second resin portion (233) extends to a lower surface of the substrate (210), and wherein the lower portion of the second resin portion (233) is connected to an upper portion of the second resin portion (233).
9. The lighting device of claim 8, wherein an outer portion of the second resin portion (233) is disposed further outside than a side surface of the substrate (210).
10. The lighting device of claim 8, wherein the phosphor layer (240) extends to a surface of the lower portion of the second resin portion (233).
11. The lighting device of any one of claims 1 to 10,

wherein the plurality of light sources (220) emits first light in a range of 420 nm to 470 nm, wherein the phosphor layer (240) converts a portion of the first light into second light in a range of 590 nm to 610 nm, wherein the first light and the second light are emitted as third light in a range of 620 nm to 630 nm through a front lens disposed on the phosphor layer.
a lighting module (200); and a lens (300) of a red color disposed on the lighting module, wherein the lighting module is the lighting device of any one of claims 1 to 11
